Customers order via the Zummey app or website, are matched with a rider within minutes and get real-time tracking from pickup to delivery, with fees starting from a few hundred naira; merchants can plug Zummey in as their delivery partner. The company uses a fleet of electric bicycles to cut emissions and, per its VC4A profile, also connects local farmers directly with consumers and supports women farmers with training and market information. ## Zummey Technologies funding1 round The latest is a Grant announced 18 Aug 2026, led by Edo State Government. ### Who has invested in Zummey Technologies - [Edo State GovernmentLead · Grant](https://www.startuplist.africa/investors/edo-state-government) | Announced | Round | Lead · investors | Amount | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 18 Aug 2026 | [Zummey Technologies Grant](https://www.startuplist.africa/funding/zummey-technologies-grant-undisclosed-1513653) 18 Aug 2026
